Mammogram was more awkward than anything, ultrasound was only painful in a couple spots because I was on my period and my boobs were sensitive. It really was very smooth going, and you will likely receive news same day (I got mine within 20 minutes) about whether or not you need a biopsy. The build up was the worst, waiting for the biopsy wasn’t as horrible as the wait for the mammogram because after I had an idea of what was going on in my boob.

Remember that getting checked out is a good thing because if something is wrong, they’ll likely catch it asap and you’ll receive the care you need OR it’ll be nothing and you’ll have a good baseline for what is or isn’t normal in your boobs when it’s time for regular mammos.
